title: Robbie Takes Over the Case
note_on_source_scope: text/ch37_37.txt 全长 8539 字符；场景题名『The Police Station』在第 17 行（字符 20-38）。第 112 行与第 134 行为分隔符『* * *』，全章两段。章末以『And – is that a hand?』收尾（cliffhanger）。

events.who: Chief Superintendent（向 Matt 与 Amy）
events.what: 站在 Matt 和 Amy 面前带着 DI Robbie Eastley 介绍交接：Robbie 接手当主案负责人；理由是 Caius 向他flag过——这些罪案发生在 Caius 父亲持有租约（leasehold）的物业上；Caius 现在会休一段年假，下周回desk duty，直到案子结案。
events.verbatim: ‘Robbie here will be taking over as the active lead on this case as Caius has flagged with me that these crimes happened on property that his father owns the leasehold on. I’m sure Caius has told you that he will now take a period of annual leave and will resume desk duty next week until the case is closed.’

events.what: Matt 伸手与 Robbie 握手（Robbie 被动地握了，『the gesture took him by surprise』）；Robbie 说『Likewise』并松手，心里并不期待接下来几周与这两人共事——只因 Caius 不在场而略感宽慰，他觉得 Caius『intimidating at the best of times』；Chief Superintendent 嘱『尽快让 Robbie 了解情况』后离开事件室去填 paperwork（心里盘算 NW1 整个邮区租约值多少钱）。
events.verbatim: ‘Great to be working with you, Robbie,’ Matt said, sticking out his hand. Robbie shook it but the gesture took him by surprise. / ‘Likewise,’ Robbie said, releasing Matt’s hand. He wasn’t looking forward to the next few weeks with these two. At least Caius wasn’t there. He found him intimidating at the best of times. ‘Amy.’ / ‘Please get Robbie up to speed as quickly as possible,’ the Chief Superintendent said. He left the incident room to deal with the paperwork that he now had to fill in, all the while wondering how much the ownership of the leasehold of a whole postcode in NW1 was worth.

events.what: Robbie 坐在 Caius 的办公桌上开口就问『little DI Fauntleroy』进行到哪一步了；Matt 忍住翻白眼，心里讨厌别人这么叫 Caius。Amy 此前曾与 Robbie 在一个案子上短暂共事，她指着白板给他讲案情大意，并刻意让他明白他们早就知道自己在做什么。
events.verbatim: ‘Right,’ Robbie said, sitting down on Caius’s desk. ‘Where had little DI Fauntleroy gotten to then?’ / Matt stopped himself from rolling his eyes. He hated it when people called Caius ‘DI Fauntleroy’. / Amy, who had briefly worked with Robbie on a case before, pointed to the whiteboards behind him. She gave him the broad gist of it all, making it very clear that they already knew what they were doing.

events.who: Robbie（向 Matt 与 Amy 复述案情）
events.what: Robbie 复述案情：Digby Combe-Watson 被一份下了毒的食物沙拉杀死，凶手是一名自称叫『Isolde』、装扮成他实习生的女子；两人通过交友广告认识，回应寄到一个 PO Box，PO Box 用一名约克郡女子的被盗信用卡信息付费；邮件由一个 incel 收取，这人名叫 Scott，被这个『假 Isolde』在附近面包店（他工作的地方）勾引，而他对店里每个女性顾客都搭讪；同一广场另有两次破门而入，其中一次导致前喜剧奇才 Jimmy Jones 意外死亡。
events.verbatim: ‘Right, so let me get this straight: Digby Combe-Watson is killed by a poisoned salad by a woman supposedly called “Isolde” who was dressed as his intern. He met her through a lonely-hearts ad that she responded to. Those responses were delivered to a PO Box, which was paid for with stolen credit card details of a Yorkshire woman, and collected by an incel called Scott that this “fake Isolde”, as you call her, had seduced in the nearby bakery that he worked in, where he hit on every other female customer who came in. There have also been two break-ins on the same square, one of which has resulted in the accidental death of former comedy enfant terrible Jimmy Jones.’

events.what: Robbie 反复打断 Amy 追问白板颜色与间距（‘What are the colours?’ / ‘They’re evenly spaced’ / ‘Is there any significance to that?’），Amy 发出恼人的咕哝；Matt 点破 Robbie 一直在打断她、她已感到受挫；Robbie 道歉并让她继续（‘Ah. Well, talk louder then.’），两人互瞪，最后 Robbie 先打破沉默说‘Sorry, Amy. Do continue.’
events.verbatim: ‘What are the colours?’ Robbie cut in. / ‘They’re evenly spaced,’ Robbie said. / ‘Is there any significance to that?’ Robbie asked. / ‘Amy’s trying to tell you the answers to your questions because we’ve already asked them ourselves, but you keep cutting her off and she is now feeling frustrated,’ Matt said. / ‘Ah. Well, talk louder then.’ Robbie stared at Amy. She stared back. They reached a stalemate. Robbie broke the silence. ‘Sorry, Amy. Do continue.’

events.who: Amy（向 Robbie 交代案情与旧账）
events.what: Amy 交代：Caius 讯问过小说家 Benedict Carr-Ridge（住 7 号），是一次破门但没丢东西、Benedict 当时喝醉；Benedict 说那房子在维多利亚时代办过降神会；Horatio Combe 就是博物馆要纪念的人，他曾带领一伙通灵者住在这广场的同样四栋房子里；广场建在中世纪修道院废墟之上，修道院据说又建在异教神庙之上；日记说这些房子被租下（或在 Horatio 情况下被买下）正因为它们是罗盘的四个基本方位点，在该地点形成一个结点；现代广场建于一百六十年前时有传言说挖出了中世纪废墟。此后她补充动机线：凶手是为拿到记录 occult 事务的日记才杀 Digby；Institute 里唯一缺的东西是手写的第二十二号日记原件，他们只有 Digby 的实习生打出来的誊本；据学生实习生 Willow 说，日记被锁起来保存，因为里面有很多奇怪的性内容；通往地下室的门上有部分指纹、地下室被封了几十年、指纹一直无法辨认；Benedict 认为窃贼进过他的地下室但他不可靠；Jimmy Jones 被中断的直播画面显示出一个窃贼（很可能同一人）从地下室楼梯所在区域出来；Caius 认为那不是巧合——有人在搜地下室。
events.verbatim: Amy began again at a normal volume. ‘Benedict told Caius that the house had been the site of seances in the Victorian era.’ … ‘He’s the guy the museum is about. He led a group of occultists that lived in these same four houses in the square. The square is built on top of the ruins of a medieval priory which in turn was supposedly built on top of a pagan temple. His diary said that these houses were rented, or purchased in Horatio’s case, specifically because they are the cardinal points of a compass and form a nexus over the site. There were rumours when the modern square was built one hundred and sixty years ago that medieval ruins were discovered.’ … ‘Having considered motives revolving around Digby’s personal life, we are now considering the idea that whoever killed Digby did it so they could gain access to the journal documenting the occult stuff. The original, handwritten twenty-second journal is the only missing thing from the Institute. We’ve only got the transcript Digby’s intern typed up.’ … ‘According to Willow, the student intern, it was kept locked away because there’s a lot of weird sex stuff in there. There was a partial print on the door to the basement which has been sealed up for decades that we’ve been unable to identify. Benedict Carr-Ridge thought the burglar had been in his basement but he’s unreliable. The footage from Jimmy Jones’s interrupted livestream shows a burglar, probably the same one, coming out of the area where the basement stairs are. Caius thought that wasn’t a coincidence. Someone is searching the basements.’

events.who: Matt（向 Robbie 交代下一步）
events.what: Matt 说他昨晚去过 35 号（地图上的黄房子），那家保安是『state of the art』，没被闯入过，但可以要求进入查看，以防有人试了又因怕被看见而中止；他们很可能会想办法进自家地下室；Caius 已申请许可拆下 Horatio Combe Institute 的地下室门，Digby 的母亲 Fenella 是唯一另一位在世的受托人，今天早上同意了；Matt 现在就过去并与法医联络。Robbie 说自己会一起去『Get a feel for the crime scene』，Amy 如释重负。
events.verbatim: ‘I went round to number 35, the yellow house on the map, last night. They’ve got really good security. State of the art. They’ve not been broken into but we could always ask to access it just in case anyone attempted to and aborted when they realised they’d be visible. It seems highly likely that they would try to get access to their basement too,’ Matt said, wrinkling his nose. ‘Caius requested permission for us to take the door down to the basement off in the Horatio Combe Institute. Digby’s mother Fenella is the only other surviving trustee and she agreed this morning. I’m going to go over there now and will liaise with forensics.’ / ‘Sure,’ Robbie said, sitting down at Caius’s desk. He’d been told. Amy scowled at him from across the desk. ‘I tell you what, Matt, I’ll come with you. Get a feel for the crime scene.’ / ‘That’s not a bad idea,’ Amy said, failing to hide her relief.

events.who: Matt（对 Robbie 的三条理由）
events.what: 上车前 Matt 叫 Robbie 别那么叫 Caius：只有对方也觉得好笑才叫，否则就是霸凌；他不愿想 Robbie 会跟 Billy Fairweather 一样坏。Robbie 辩称 Billy 是个好人，是 little DI Fauntleroy 先动手打了他还大闹。Matt 给出三条理由：(1) Caius 是因为 Billy 用侮辱性称呼形容他的祖父才动手打 Billy，因为 Billy 不知道 Caius 的背景；(2) Caius 确实因此被停职，但他会记笔记，手里有一整份关于 Billy 说过做过什么的卷宗，Billy 已被举报过两次而一直没被处理；(3) Matt 上班第一周看到 Billy 在警局停车场的警车里用钥匙吸古柯碱，Billy 发现他看见后叫他『chink』并说要是告发就毁了他。Matt 要 Robbie 别再搞那套 DI Fauntleroy，并尊重 Amy——『Not because she’s good at her job, but because she’s a person.』
events.verbatim: ‘It’s only funny if the other person thinks it is. If not it becomes bullying. I wouldn’t like to think you were as bad as Billy Fairweather.’ / ‘Billy was a good lad. Not his fault little DI Fauntleroy socked him one and had the nerve to kick up a fuss about it.’ / ‘Three things. Two of them are easily verifiable and the third you’ll just have to take my word for. Firstly, Caius snapped and hit Billy because he used a slur to describe his grandfather because Billy didn’t realise what Caius’s background was. Secondly, he did get suspended for hitting him, but the thing about Caius is that he takes notes and he had a whole dossier on shit Billy had said and done. He’d already reported him twice and nothing had happened. Thirdly, on my first week working here I saw Billy doing a line of coke off his keys in his police car in the car park. He called me a “chink” when he realised I saw and said he’d ruin me if I told. So, yeah, no more of that DI Fauntleroy shit, and treat Amy with respect. Not because she’s good at her job, but because she’s a person.’ Matt got in the car.

events.who: Matt / 法医 / 一名法医（声音自深处传来）
events.what: Matt 在 35 号找 Mel（想一个人静一静从 Robbie 那里缓过来），她不开门；他再次把名片塞进门缝、背面留条请她回电；他想着或许他们的监控能拍到窃贼。他回到 Robbie 身边。法医团队在 Horatio Combe Institute 正忙着凿掉门上一层层厚漆（『the century’s thick layer of paint』），终于把门从铰链上卸下并连门带走作证物（门上确有部分指纹）。一名法医先下去，穿着防化服；地下室不知多少年没有新鲜空气；Matt 用袖子捂住口鼻。深处传上来一句话：有个水晶球、桌上的塔罗牌，还有——『is that a hand?』
events.verbatim: Matt called in on Mel at number 35, he needed a moment away from Robbie to collect himself, but she didn’t answer the door. He put his card through again with a note on the back asking her to call. He thought there was an off-chance that their security cameras may have caught the burglar. … The forensics team who met them at the Horatio Combe Institute were busy chipping away at the century’s thick layer of paint over the door. Finally they managed to take it off its hinges. They took the door back with them as evidence. It had a partial print on it, after all. A member of forensics went down first. They had a hazmat suit on. The basement hadn’t had fresh air since Lord knows when. Matt put his sleeve over his mouth and nose in a futile effort not to smell the staleness that had begun to waft up the staircase. / ‘There’s a crystal ball,’ their voice carried back up from the depths. ‘And tarot cards on the table too. And – is that a hand?’

relationships: Robbie Eastley（DI）— 本章新上任的主案负责人；与 Chief Superintendent 同来，由后者正式宣布交接。
Robbie 与 Amy：Amy 曾与 Robbie 在另一个案子上短暂共事（Amy, who had briefly worked with Robbie on a case before）；本章 Amy 对 Robbie 频繁打断不满，但 Robbie 主动要跟去现场时 Amy 明显松了口气。
Robbie 与 Matt：本章初次合作；Matt 主动伸手握手，Robbie 被这一举动弄得意外。
Robbie 与 Caius：Robbie 叫 Caius ‘little DI Fauntleroy’ / ‘DI Fauntleroy’，Robbie 觉得 Caius『intimidating at the best of times』；Robbie 与 Billy Fairweather 是旧识（‘Billy was a good lad’）。
Caius（DI Fauntleroy）— 因其父亲持有涉案物业的租约而与本案有利害关系，故将主案交给 Robbie；本人休年假、下周回 desk duty 直至结案；此前曾因打 Billy Fairweather 被停职；有卷宗式记笔记的习惯。
Chief Superintendent — 下令『Please get Robbie up to speed as quickly as possible』，随后离开事件室去填 paperwork。
Matt — 侦办本案的老成员；第 1 周就见过 Billy 在警车里吸古柯碱；与 Robbie 一起前往 Institute。
Amy — 本案侦办成员，负责向 Robbie 交底（白板、seances、Horatio Combe、日记动机、指纹与直播证据）。
Billy Fairweather — 同事；曾用侮辱性称呼形容 Caius 的祖父；曾被 Caius 打了一拳并因此让 Caius 被停职；后被 Caius 举报两次均无事；Matt 见过他在警局停车场警车里用钥匙吸古柯碱；他叫 Matt『chink』并威胁毁了他。
Digby Combe-Watson — 死者，被下了毒的食物沙拉杀死（伪装成实习生的『Isolde』所为）。
『Isolde』— 假冒身份、装扮成 Digby 的实习生的女性；被 Scott 认为是 seduce 了他的人。
Scott — incel，在附近面包店工作，收取 PO Box 邮件；对店里每个女性顾客都搭讪；被『假 Isolde』勾引。
Benedict Carr-Ridge — 住 7 号的小说家；被 Caius 讯问；案发时喝醉；其家是破门现场但未失窃；关于『窃贼进过他地下室』的说法不可靠（unreliable）。
Horatio Combe — 博物馆要纪念的人；曾带领一伙通灵者住在广场同样四栋房子；其日记记下这四栋房子因是罗盘四方位点而形成结点。
Willow — 学生实习生；说那本日记被锁起来保存，因为里面有很多奇怪的性内容。
Fenella — Digby 的母亲，唯一另一位在世的受托人，今早同意拆门。
Jimmy Jones — 前喜剧奇才（comedy enfant terrible），破门事件中意外死亡；其被中断的直播画面拍到一名从地下室楼梯区域出来的窃贼。
Mel — 住在 35 号；本章未开门（Matt 留名片与字条请她回电）。
Horatio Combe Institute — 博物馆/Institute，Digby 母亲的信托机构；地下室被封了几十年。
